svg.aria-label: Six years of DP-SGD on CIFAR-10: test accuracy against the privacy budget ε
svg.text: Six years of DP-SGD on CIFAR-10: test accuracy against the privacy budget ε
Models trained from scratch with DP-SGD at δ = 10⁻⁵. The 2022 curve uses no extra data; it is better training, not weaker privacy.
